nodes.title: LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀

en.text:
**LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀**
- Starts the picture at half size and grows it to full size partway through. About 2x faster sampling, same quality **(roughly 33% off a full run).**
- Lives on the **High Pass Sampler** only. The low pass finishes at full size.
- **auto (pick):** grows at the right step for the schedule.
- **grow_at_step:** set it yourself when auto is off. **0 = off.**
- ⚠️ The layout follows the model's trained size, so a seed frames a bit tighter with it on. Re-rendering an old seed? Set grow_at_step to 0 for that run.
- Upscale and image to image passes run as normal: their layout comes from your image.
- 🤔 **meh** factor: This changes the image slightly when turned on and off on the same seed 🌱

nodes.title: LC Model Optimizer ⚡

en.text:
## 🛑🚫✋ Run the report first!
- **Settings > LC123 Settings ⚙️ > Optimization > System & Model Optimization Report**. It tests your machine in about 10 seconds.
- The optimizer reads that report to pick the right files and speed-ups for YOUR card. No report = Comfy's default files.

**LC Model Optimizer ⚡**
- It replaces your model, text encoder and VAE loaders. One node, the first thing in the graph.
- Pick the **base model** (Krea 2, Z-Image, Qwen-Image, SDXL, etc.).
- Pick a **goal**:
    - **Quality:** closest to the full model.
    - **Optimal:** fast and near identical (the default, and the one most people want).
    - **Fast:** the fastest that still looks right.
- Leave every file on **★ Recommended** and hit Run. That's it.
- Missing a file? It shows as **⬇ Download** and grabs it on the first run (check the console, big files take a while).
- Want your own file (a finetune, a merge, Krealism)? Click the picker and choose it. Your files that match the base model are listed first.
- Using something it doesn't know? Set the base model to **Custom**, pick your files, and the speed-ups still apply.
- 💡 Leave **speed_ups** on **Auto**. It only turns on what actually passed the test on your machine. Manual is for people who like to tinker.

**Read the panel on the node before you run**
- ✅ the file is on disk · ⬇️ it will download · 📦 it comes from the checkpoint.
- It shows your time per step and whether the model fits on your card.
- ⚠️ means a file doesn't belong to the base model (e.g. the wrong text encoder). It will still let you run it, but expect errors or bad results.

**LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡**
- The same thing for video (MiniMax H3, LTX 2.5 / 2.3), plus the audio VAE and the latent upscaler.
- A part the model doesn't use says **not used by**. Leave it wired, it does no harm.

---

nodes.title: LC Speed Boost 🚀 KSampler (BETA)

en.text:
**Acts like a standard Ksampler, but with the following exceptions...**

Runs **SPEED**

**speed_boost**
- *auto* determines the best place in the schedule to change depending on the model and steps. if you want to do it manually or bypass, turn it off (grow_at_step)
- grow_at_step is the step the size increases and SPEED stops. 
   - set to 0 to *bypass*
   - always leave 1-2 steps for it to grow

**Options**
- you can plug a sampler in directly if you want to use a detailer daemon or custom sampler
- you can use this as the **first pass** of a chained set of samplers
- you can plug a **ClownSamplerSelector** in and use *Res4Lyf* samplers (you're welcome)
